caption: The drawing depicts a textile design composed of repeated geometric patterns in red, blue, and white colors. The top edge has a border of white fringe. The first row consists of a horizontal band featuring blue geometric motifs against a white background. Below this, there are two prominent horizontal rows of eight-pointed star shapes, the upper row in red and the lower row alternating between red and blue. Each star is made up of small rectangular blocks forming checkerboard and radiating patterns. The bottom section of the textile features a diagonal corner cut-out on the left, with more blue and red geometric patterns mirroring sections of the upper design. The entire composition is set on an off-white or light beige background, and the textile slows clear repetitive symmetry with alternating red and blue colors in the stars and checked blocks.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
